meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 将解析出的文档和你的分析目标转换成四色卡片：蓝卡记录事实并附来源，绿卡解释机制背景，黄卡提示风险须复核，红卡给出下一步行动。所有卡片都要求有来源，保证可回溯。
howto.when: 当用户提交已解析好的文档并给出明确的分析意图（希望获取事实、解释、风险或行动建议，或要求整体四色卡片）时触发。

say.text: 请根据这份文档的解析结果，生成四色卡片。
say.note: 将输出蓝、绿、黄、红四类卡片，各自附带来源。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这篇报告，标出主要风险。
say.note: 黄卡会经复核后交付，突出过度声明等内容。

say.text: 把刚才解析的内容变成卡片，先给我事实蓝卡。
say.note: 会优先抽取事实并标注来源。

howto.what_en: Converts parsed documents and your analysis goal into four colored cards: blue for facts with sources, green for mechanism/background explanations, yellow for risks requiring review, red for next-step actions. All cards are traceable to sources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides an already-parsed document and a clear intent (e.g., wanting facts, explanations, risks, or action suggestions, or an overall four-color breakdown).

say_en.text: Please generate four-color cards from this parsed document.
say_en.note: Outputs blue, green, yellow, red cards, each with sources.

say_en.text: Analyze this report with four-color cards, highlighting main risks.
say_en.note: Yellow card is delivered after review, flagging exaggerations.

say_en.text: Turn that parsed content into cards, start with a fact card.
say_en.note: Extracts facts first with source citations.
